locations.name: Kuat Sector Command Garrison
locations.last_event: A routine prisoner transfer went wrong when the detainee revealed concealed cortosis weave armor and escaped into the ventilation system.
secrets: The garrison commander has been skimming weapons shipments and selling E-11 blaster rifles to a Pyke Syndicate contact.
A sealed sublevel contains prototype interrogation droids that were officially decommissioned.

locations.name: Imperial Intelligence Listening Post Besh-7
locations.last_event: Intercepted a coded Rebel transmission referencing an operative embedded within the post itself — no one knows who to trust.
secrets: The protocol droid has been reprogrammed by Rebel sympathizers and is relaying sanitized intelligence reports.
One analyst discovered the mole's identity but was silenced with a neurotoxin before they could report it.
The listening post sits atop an ancient Jedi waystation buried during the Clone Wars.

locations.name: Tarkin Initiative Research Annex
locations.last_event: An experimental bioweapon breached containment in Lab Section Aurek, killing three researchers before emergency protocols sealed the wing.
secrets: The bioweapon was derived from Dathomir nightsister alchemy, not conventional Imperial science.
A surviving researcher has been secretly documenting the experiments on a hidden datapad, hoping to defect.

locations.name: Moff Delvaris's Administrative Tower
locations.last_event: Moff Delvaris received a death mark hologram from Black Sun and has tripled her personal security detail.
secrets: Delvaris is negotiating a secret ceasefire with a Rebel cell to eliminate a mutual Black Sun rival.
The tower's transparisteel observation deck conceals a hidden turbolaser emplacement.

locations.name: COMPNOR Youth Recruitment Center
locations.last_event: A teenager smuggled an anti-Imperial holozine into the center, and three recruits have gone missing since its discovery.
secrets: The recruitment center doubles as a screening facility for Force-sensitive children, who are quietly transferred off-world.
A hidden room behind the holoprojector stores confiscated personal belongings that were supposed to be destroyed.

locations.name: Sector Detention Block Aurek-12
locations.last_event: A prisoner exchange with the Hutts went sideways when the Hutt envoy was assassinated in the lobby by an unknown sniper.
secrets: Cell block seven houses a former Jedi Padawan kept sedated with Class-4 neural suppressants.
The head guard runs a gambling ring using confiscated credit chips from prisoners.

locations.name: Fulcrum Safehouse — The Luma Den
locations.last_event: An operative returned from a dead drop missing two fingers and carrying a datacube encrypted with an unknown Imperial cipher.
secrets: The cantina's fermentation tanks contain hidden compartments used to smuggle thermal detonators.
The owner's daughter is an unwitting ISB informant, reporting her mother's visitors to a handler she believes is a suitor.

locations.name: Rebel Communications Bunker Cresh-4
locations.last_event: A burst transmission from Alliance High Command revealed that an Imperial fleet is en route — evacuation protocols have been initiated.
secrets: The bunker's power generator is failing and has maybe twelve hours of operation left.
A Pathfinder scout discovered Separatist-era battle droid parts in a collapsed tunnel nearby.

locations.name: Onderon Rebel Cell Field Hospital
locations.last_event: A critically wounded Imperial defector arrived carrying a datachip with garrison patrol schedules — but his injuries suggest he may have been allowed to escape.
secrets: The bacta supply is almost gone; the medics have been diluting it with kolto and hoping no one notices.
The 2-1B droid's memory banks contain the location of a hidden Separatist medical cache.

locations.name: Saw's Partisan Forward Armory
locations.last_event: Saw Gerrera's partisans cleared out in haste after an internal purge — at least two bodies remain, killed by vibroblade wounds, not blaster fire.
secrets: A crate of kyber crystal shards is hidden behind a collapsed wall section, wrapped in lead-lined cloth.
One of the dead partisans has a coded journal detailing a planned assassination of a Rebel Alliance senator.
A proximity-triggered proton charge is wired to the main entrance, set by the departing partisans.

locations.name: Rebel Hangar Bay — Whisper Base
locations.last_event: A supply run returned with only half the expected fuel — the other half was intercepted by pirates who knew the exact route.
secrets: One of the X-wing fighters has a malfunctioning transponder that periodically broadcasts its location on an Imperial frequency.
The quartermaster has been trading surplus weapons to a local Mandalorian clan in exchange for beskar patches for hull repairs.

locations.name: Grakkus the Hutt's Trophy Vault
locations.last_event: A thief bypassed the vault's ray shields and stole a Sith holocron — Grakkus has placed a 50,000-credit bounty on their head.
secrets: Grakkus possesses a functioning Jedi lightsaber hidden inside a hollowed-out rancor tusk trophy.
The majordomo is embezzling spice profits and funneling them to an orphanage on Ryloth.

locations.name: The Obsidian Orchid — Black Sun Social Club
locations.last_event: A Bothan information broker was found dead in the refresher, strangled with a garrote wire — the security holorecordings for that hour have been wiped.
secrets: The lounge's sabacc tables are rigged with micro-repulsorlifts controlled by the dealer's ring.
A hidden turbolift behind the bar descends to a slave processing facility.
The vigo is secretly dying of a degenerative disease and has not named a successor.

locations.name: Crimson Dawn Coaxium Warehouse
locations.last_event: A coaxium shipment arrived unstable and nearly detonated — three laborers were killed in the containment breach, and the supplier has gone silent.
secrets: The warehouse floor conceals a tunnel network connecting to the city's old sewer system — an escape route known only to the site commander.
One of the laborers is a Mandalorian warrior stripped of their armor, biding their time.

locations.name: Pyke Syndicate Spice Refinery
locations.last_event: An entire batch of processed glitterstim was contaminated with a neurotoxin — sabotage is suspected but no one is talking.
secrets: The refinery's ventilation system has been gradually poisoning the chemists with trace spice residue, causing hallucinations.
A hidden safe contains blackmail holos of an Imperial sector governor partaking in spice.

locations.name: The Exchange Data Parlor
locations.last_event: A slicer cracked an Imperial encryption key and has been selling copies to the highest bidder — three factions are now racing to acquire it.
secrets: The infochant maintains a dead man's switch that will broadcast compromising data on every client if they are killed.
A back room houses a neural interface chair used for involuntary memory extraction.

locations.name: The Krayt's Maw — Bounty Posting House
locations.last_event: Two hunters returned claiming the same bounty — one produced a severed hand, the other a cryo-frozen head. The guild liaison has locked down payouts pending verification.
secrets: The lodge's fighting pit conceals a smuggler's tunnel that exits two blocks away in a junk dealer's shop.
The guild liaison has been inflating bounty values and skimming the difference for years.

locations.name: Kessel Run Staging Den
locations.last_event: A smuggler returned from the Kessel Run with an uncharted hyperspace route recorded in their navicomputer — and half the Outer Rim wants it.
secrets: The den's droid chop-shop has been reprogramming Imperial probe droids and selling them as surveillance tools.
A hidden compartment in the ceiling rafters holds 200,000 credits in untraceable bearer bonds.

locations.name: Gorga's Arena of Agony
locations.last_event: A captured Wookiee gladiator broke free and killed two Nikto handlers before being stunned — Gorga is now offering triple pay for anyone who can tame the beast.
secrets: The arena's subfloor cages connect to old mining tunnels that lead outside the city.
Gorga is planning to betray a rival Hutt by poisoning the celebratory feast at next week's Grand Melee.

locations.name: Mos Espa Lower Market Bazaar
locations.last_event: A Jawa trading party arrived with a crate of unidentified Clone Wars-era technology that is attracting dangerous attention.
secrets: The Toydarian junk dealer has a working Republic-era holoprojector that contains a partial Jedi Council recording.
A seemingly ordinary moisture vaporator on display is actually a disguised signal booster used by a Rebel cell.

locations.name: The Starboard Turn — Corellian Spacer's Cantina
locations.last_event: A drunken spacer claimed to have seen a Star Destroyer under construction in a hidden shipyard — he was found dead in the alley the next morning.
secrets: The cantina's back room hosts a weekly high-stakes sabacc game attended by mid-level crime bosses.
The Duros bartender is a retired Rebel operative who still maintains a network of informants across three systems.

locations.name: Alderaanian Cultural Preservation Society
locations.last_event: An anonymous donor delivered a sealed container of Alderaanian soil — its authenticity has sparked both hope and suspicion of an Imperial trap.
secrets: The society's archive contains encrypted coordinates to a hidden Alderaanian seed vault on a remote moon.
The lead archivist is Princess Leia's childhood tutor and maintains indirect contact with the Rebel Alliance.

locations.name: Grek's Fuel Stop and Grill
locations.last_event: Imperial officers confiscated the diner's entire supply of Corellian ale, claiming it was contraband — the real reason was to pressure Grek into informing.
secrets: Grek hides fugitives in a false-bottomed freezer unit behind the kitchen.
The diner's jukebox contains a hidden compartment where patrons leave coded messages for a local Rebel cell.

locations.name: Dr. Vossk's Outer Rim Clinic
locations.last_event: A patient arrived with a blaster wound and an Imperial tracking implant embedded in their shoulder — removing it would alert the Empire, leaving it risks everyone.
secrets: Dr. Vossk performs unlicensed cybernetic implantations in the basement for those who can pay.
A locked cabinet contains three doses of a rare antitoxin worth 10,000 credits each on the black market.

locations.name: Monastery of the Central Isopter
locations.last_event: The monks' meditation chamber began resonating with an unidentifiable harmonic frequency that shattered every transparisteel panel in the building.
secrets: The monastery was built atop a vergence in the Force, and the monks unknowingly channel its energy during their rituals.
The caretaker droid's memory core dates to the High Republic era and contains star charts to forgotten Jedi outposts.

locations.name: Docking Bay 87 — Ord Mantell Spaceport
locations.last_event: A YT-2400 freighter landed with its crew unconscious and the autopilot engaged — no one knows who programmed the landing sequence.
secrets: Bay 87's fuel lines have been tapped by a slicer who sells discounted fuel to smugglers at a 40% markup from what they steal.
The customs droid has been compromised and waves through any cargo tagged with a specific Pyke Syndicate transponder code.

locations.name: Port Tooga — Shadowport Trading Floor
locations.last_event: An arms dealer unveiled a crate of Mandalorian vambraces and a bidding war nearly turned into a firefight.
secrets: Port Tooga's location shifts every standard month — the current coordinates are only shared via a dead-drop network.
The shadowport's administrator is a former Imperial Moff who faked their own death.

locations.name: Coronet City Central Transit Hub
locations.last_event: An Imperial checkpoint scanner malfunctioned and flagged every passenger as a wanted fugitive, causing a stampede that injured twelve people.
secrets: A maintenance corridor beneath Platform 7 connects to the old Corellian resistance tunnels from the Clone Wars.
A vendor selling roasted nuna legs is actually a Rebel courier exchanging datachips hidden inside the food containers.

locations.name: Rishi Station Refueling Depot
locations.last_event: A fuel tanker arrived with its cargo bay sealed from the inside — when they cut it open, they found a family of Togruta refugees who had been hiding for three standard weeks.
secrets: The depot manager is laundering credits for a Hutt Cartel subsidiary through inflated fuel invoices.
Fuel Cell 9 has a slow leak that has been creating a volatile gas pocket in the sublevel — one spark and the whole depot goes.

locations.name: Abandoned Kaminoan Cloning Sublaboratory
locations.last_event: A scavenger team broke through a sealed door and found rows of intact cloning tanks — one of them still has power and something is growing inside.
secrets: The active cloning tank contains a partially-developed clone of an unknown human — genetic markers suggest Jango Fett's template.
A hidden databank in the facility stores the complete Kaminoan cloning genome database.
The facility's automated defense systems are dormant but not deactivated — any significant power draw will reactivate them.

locations.name: Threshold of the Sith Temple of Vaal
locations.last_event: A group of treasure hunters entered the temple three standard days ago — only their comlinks remain, endlessly broadcasting static and whispered Sith incantations.
secrets: The temple's inner sanctum contains a meditation focus that amplifies dark side abilities but slowly corrupts the user.
A Force ghost of the temple's last guardian remains, testing any who enter with visions of their deepest fears.
The cave walls are inscribed with a Sith alchemical formula for creating cortosis-laced armor.

locations.name: The Librarium of Ossus — Hidden Archive
locations.last_event: The guardian droid activated for the first time in centuries after detecting a Force-sensitive presence entering the outer tunnels.
secrets: The archive contains holocrons from twelve different Jedi Masters, each teaching a forgotten lightsaber form.
A sealed vault requires Force telekinesis to open and contains a map to the original Jedi homeworld.

locations.name: Nightsister Altar of the Fading Moon
locations.last_event: A lone Nightsister returned to the altar and performed a resurrection ritual — it partially worked, and now something walks the caves that should not.
secrets: The altar can be used to craft a talisman that grants temporary immunity to Force mind-affecting powers.
The resurrected entity retains fragmented memories of General Grievous's assault on Dathomir.

locations.name: Kessel Deep Core Mining Rig 7
locations.last_event: A tunnel collapse trapped fourteen miners in Shaft Besh — rescue efforts are stalled because the Pykes refuse to halt production in adjacent shafts.
secrets: The deepest shaft has broken through into a natural cavern containing unrefined coaxium deposits worth millions.
A Wookiee labor leader is organizing a coordinated revolt timed to coincide with the next shift change.
One of the mining droids has been reprogrammed to map escape routes and transmit them to an Abolitionist network.

locations.name: Bespin Tibanna Gas Processing Platform Delta
locations.last_event: An Ugnaught union representative was found frozen in a carbonite block in the loading bay — no one has claimed responsibility.
secrets: Platform Delta has been secretly processing spin-sealed tibanna gas for Imperial weapons contracts while publicly claiming neutrality.
An Ugnaught technician discovered that the platform's repulsorlift array is degrading — without repairs, it will lose altitude within six standard months.

locations.name: Czerka Arms Prototype Testing Facility
locations.last_event: A prototype disruptor pistol overloaded during testing and vaporized the firing range wall, revealing a previously unknown chamber behind it.
secrets: The hidden chamber contains old Czerka records from the Mandalorian Wars, including schematics for a mass-shadow generator component.
Czerka is developing a neural-linked targeting system that requires involuntary test subjects — several are being held in sublevel cells.

locations.name: Clan Rook's Hidden Beskar Forge
locations.last_event: An Imperial Inquisitor tracked a Force-sensitive foundling to the forge — the clan repelled the attack but knows more will come.
secrets: The forge contains enough beskar to outfit an entire company of warriors, hidden during the Great Purge.
The armorer possesses a fragment of the Darksaber's original mold, a relic of immense cultural significance.

locations.name: Clan Wren Forward Safehouse
locations.last_event: A coded transmission arrived containing proof that a fellow clan member has been feeding intel to an Imperial Super Commando unit.
secrets: The safehouse armory contains a pair of Whistling Bird launchers — extremely rare and jealously guarded.
The Nite Owl operative carries sealed orders from Bo-Katan Kryze herself, meant only for the clan chief.

locations.name: Lothal Displacement Camp 4
locations.last_event: The Imperial liaison announced ration cuts of 30%, and tensions are reaching a breaking point — a riot is one bad day away.
secrets: The Ithorian aid coordinator is smuggling children off-world to families on Alderaan — or was, before its destruction.
Buried beneath Tent Row 7 is a cache of hunting blasters hidden by farmers who refused to surrender their weapons.
The Imperial liaison genuinely wants to help but is being pressured by their superiors to provoke an incident that justifies a crackdown.

locations.name: The Jawbone — Crashed Separatist Frigate
locations.last_event: A power surge reactivated the ship's central computer, which began broadcasting a decades-old Separatist distress signal — attracting Imperial scouts.
secrets: The frigate's still-intact armory contains crates of droideka components that could be reassembled by a skilled mechanic.
The central computer holds navigation logs pointing to a Separatist gold reserve hidden in the Unknown Regions.
A scavenger scratched a warning into the hull near the engine room: 'DON'T WAKE THE TACTICAL DROID.'
